title: Add simple local runner and usage docs for smoke targets
acceptance_criteria: `python3 .tmp/local-smoke-tests/run_all.py steam-web payday2-web desktop` runs the targets sequentially and returns non-zero if any target fails.
The usage docs explain that the smoke assets are local-only and should remain uncommitted by default.
The docs include the intended validation commands for Steam Deals Web, PAYDAY 2 Web, and desktop launcher smoke coverage.
completion_summary: Se agrego runner local y docs de uso para ejecutar smoke targets reproducibles.
